an10.80:1.3: anatthamme acari, taṃ kutettha labbhāti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
an10.80:1.4: anatthamme carati, taṃ kutettha labbhāti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
an10.80:1.5: anatthamme carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhāti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
an10.80:1.6: piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari …pe… anatthaṃ
an10.80:1.8: carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhāti āghātaṃ paṭivineti. appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari …pe…
an10.80:1.10: atthaṃ carissati taṃ kutettha labbhāti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
an10.80:1.12: ime kho bhikkhave dasa āghāta paṭivinayāti.
